about_the_game:
a. General Introduction:

Street Soccer Online is a fast-paced multiplayer street soccer game that captures the energy and fun of the sport. With no rules to hold you back, this game delivers a pure, exhilarating soccer experience. Play as both a player and a goalkeeper, and immerse yourself in the spirit of street soccer!

b. Key Features (Demo):

  • No Rules Soccer: Feel the freedom and dynamism of street soccer.

  • Play as Both Player and Goalkeeper: Show your skills in every position on the field.

  • Fast and Fun: Simple controls make it easy to play, but hard to master.

  • One Map (For Demo)

  • 3 Playable Characters

  • Realistic Physics: Create strategies with realistic football movements and collisions

c. Game Mechanics:

In Street Soccer Online, the goal is simple: score goals, outplay your opponents, and have fun! Players can dribble, shoot, and tackle on the field or block shots as a goalkeeper. Matches are short and fast-paced, maximizing the excitement and fun factor.

d. Developer’s Note:

"One Developer, One Big Dream"
Street Soccer Online is a project built entirely by a solo developer. Capturing the essence of street soccer and sharing it with players has been my ultimate goal. I am committed to improving the game with your feedback and taking it to the next level. Your support on this journey means everything to me!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10,11
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD processor of 2.5 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
